answer_1.quote: we first develop a benchmark SJTP that consists of SubJective ToPics with free responses.

answer_2.quote: Considering the inherent challenge in quantifying the quality of free responses to subjective questions, we carefully craft three automated evaluation indicators.

answer_3.quote: For evaluation, we take the sota GPT-4 as the evaluator.

answer_4.quote: To further validate the rationality of the proposed evaluation indicators, we conduct a blind A/B human evaluation on a subset of the responses given by different methods to select the preferred response.
answer_4.guideline: a human judge was presented with a question and two candidate responses generated by the baseline methods and NeoN. The judge was then asked to select the response that is better.
